name: Rhea Raj
bio: Rhea Sri Rajagopalan (born April 5, 2000), known professionally as Rhea Raj, is an American singer and songwriter. She released her first album, Hunter, in 2024. Stamford, Connecticut, U.S.

credits.title: Priyanka! What's My Name?
credits.overview: After hitting a breaking point, drag superstar Priyanka is forced to reevaluate her life, identity, and relationships.
